- **What happened:** Objective "Seize throne" at (11,1). Only the outer brigands are aggressive; the boss merc (Glass) and the brigand inside the temple never left it until the wall opened. Turns 1-5: Lyn on plain/forest tiles baited three brigands one at a time (her 8x2 counter at 100% left each at 4, Kent's sword or Sain's lance finished). Sain missed twice on turn 4 and dropped to 1 HP; he sat on the fort at (3,2) for the rest of the map. The temple is sealed: column 8 is wall, and the south approach is only reachable over mountains, which cavalry cannot cross. The tile at (8,3) is terrain ID 0x1B, a **breakable wall with 30 HP** — the action menu at (7,3) offered Attack with no enemy in range. `fe7_act attack` refuses it (no enemy in range), so I used raw presses (select via fe7_reachable keep_selected, A, A on Attack, A on the weapon, A to confirm) once per turn on turns 6-8; Kent's 11 dmg broke it in three hits and it became Floor. The inside brigand then walked into the gap and died on Kent's counter (turn 9). Kent hit the boss on the throne (7 dmg at 85%, its counter 4) on turns 10-11; a miss left Kent at 4 HP, so Lyn finished it from (12,1) with 5x2 on turn 11 and seized on turn 12.
- **Army:** Lyn L4 17/17, Iron Sword 26, Mani Katti 45 (slot 4, NOT equipped), Vulneraries 1/3/3 uses. Kent L3 22/22, Iron Sword 30, Iron Lance 45, Vulnerary 2. Sain L1 19/19, Iron Lance 41, no vulnerary. Wil (archer, cls32, L1, 17 HP, Iron Bow 30, Vulnerary 3) joined for Ch.3.

(2) Guard-type enemies inside sealed rooms do not attack the wall themselves; you have to open it. (3) A unit standing on a fort heals 3/turn. (4) Kent vs the throne boss is a 7-dmg-for-4 trade at 85/93% hit; Lyn's doubled 5x2 is the finisher once it is under 10. (5) The end-of-chapter Save prompt is the three-slot screen again: A on slot 1, A on Save.
- **Between chapters:** Saved to game slot 1 (the used slot) at the Save prompt. Ch.3 title card seen; no prep screen, Start x3 landed on the Ch.3 map at turn 1.
- **Next:** Ch.3 Band of Mercenaries, turn 1, player phase, opening dialogue may still be on screen (use fe7_unstick/fe7_wait first). Lyn (1,8), Sain (4,8), Kent (2,9), Wil (2,7) in the SW; 9 enemies: Lv6 brigand boss at (13,0) with a Steel Axe (0x20), 3 mercs (cls0A), 3 brigands, 2 archers (cls18, Iron Bows) at (8,7) and (11,3). Nearest threats: merc at (5,4), brigand (8,4), archer (8,7). Objective not yet read. State saved at playthrough/states/s04_ch03_band-of-mercenaries.ss.

## s05 — Ch.3 Band of Mercenaries (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 12

- **Gained:** Florina (pegasus knight) joined on turn 1 from the opening event. Kent L3 -> L4 (24 HP, S7 K7 P8 D6 R2). No other level-ups, no drops. One village visited (3,6) by Florina; the brigand from (12,2) walked onto the other village at (2,2) on turn 4 and it is presumably burned.
- **NAMES (correction to s04):** slot #3 (cls32, 17 HP, S5 K7 P9 D4 R4 L7, item 0x15 = Slim Lance x30) is **Florina**, not Wil. Slot #4 (cls18, 20 HP, S6 K5 P5 D5 R0 L6, item 0x2C = Iron Bow) is **Wil**. cls18 is the Archer class (the enemy archers are cls18 too), cls32 is Pegasus Knight. Wil has no vulnerary; Florina carries one (3 uses).
- **What happened:** Objective "Defeat enemy" (rout), 9 enemies. The west start pocket is sealed by village walls (terrain 0x2E, impassable) and fences (0x19) except through the road at (5-9,6-9); the north half is reached only via column 11-14 at row 5. Aggressive enemies came one at a time: archer (turn 2, killed by Lyn from (4,9) with no counter), brigand and merc (turns 3-4, Kent from (8,8)), merc (turn 5, Wil chip + Lyn), west brigand (turns 6-7, Kent bait at (4,7), Wil chip, Florina kill). The four northern enemies (boss, brigand (8,4), merc (14,5), archer (11,3)) are guard-type: each only moved once a unit entered its move+attack range, then came at us and died on the next player phase (archer to Kent 9x2, brigand to Wil + Lyn, merc to Lyn's counter + Florina). Boss Migal (Lv6 brigand, Steel Axe, 25 HP, D5, stationary) on turn 12: Wil 7 from (13,2), Florina 3x2 from (13,1) (took a 15-damage counter, 2/17), Kent 8x2 from (12,0) killed him at 100% with no counter.
- **Army:** Lyn L4 17/17, Iron Sword 20, Vulneraries 3/3, Mani Katti 45 (slot 3, NOT equipped). Sain L1 17/19, Iron Lance 41, no vulnerary. Kent L4 24/24, Iron Sword 22 (slot 0), Iron Lance 45, no vulnerary (both used). Florina L1 2/17, Slim Lance 28, Vulnerary 3. Wil L2 20/20, Iron Bow 42. The game heals everyone between chapters.

(3) Florina's Slim Lance does 3-5 damage and she eats 14-15 from axes — use her only for guaranteed finishes on units already under 5 HP; a boss counter nearly killed her. (4) fe7_act 'visit' worked: the Village tile gave the "Florina" event text and Florina joined (the join is the Ch.3 opening event; the village itself gave nothing I could see). (5) The end of the chapter went straight to the Ch.4 title card with no save prompt seen; nothing was chosen.

- **Next:** Ch.4 In Occupation's Shadow, turn 1, player phase, opening dialogue (Kent/Sain) still on screen — use fe7_unstick/fe7_wait first; enemies had not spawned yet when I read the state (0 listed) and only 3 of 5 players were deployed, so re-read fe7_state after the cutscene clears. A green NPC (cls48, 10 HP, at (7,3)) is present — this is very likely a Defend/Protect chapter (survive N turns, keep the NPC alive); read the objective from the opening screenshot before moving. - **Lost:** Sain, enemy phase of turn 3, holding (5,8) at 12/19 HP with no vulnerary; two brigand hits (7 each) killed him. BUT the Ch.5 roster lists slot #1 cls28 19/19 (Sain) again at turn 1 — the game appears to have brought him back for Ch.5; next session should confirm by looking.
- **Gained:** Lyn L4 -> L5 (18 HP, S5 K10 P11 D2 R2 L7) from two enemy-phase counter-kills on turn 6, plus an Iron Axe drop (0x1F) in her inventory. Kent L4 -> L5 -> L6 (24 HP). Natalie survived untouched.
- **What happened:** Objective "Protect" (survive 7 turns; Natalie, green cls48, sits at (7,3) in a one-door room whose doorway is (7,4)). 14 enemies + reinforcements (mercs from (14,0), brigands from (1,13) every turn). Turns 1-3 I held the two-wide south entrance (5,8)/(6,8) with Kent and Sain (killed 4), Wil on the east door (10,5), Lyn inside. The west group spent turns 1-4 breaking the wall at (3,4) and the archer shot Lyn THROUGH the wall from (2,6) when she stood at (4,6). Sain died turn 3 EP. From turn 4 I turtled: the plug tile is (7,5) (only (7,6) can melee it; (6,6)/(8,6)/(7,7) can shoot it) and nothing at (7,5) or behind can be reached, so Natalie is safe. Kent held (7,5) turns 4-5 (24 -> 7 HP), then Lyn with the Mani Katti turns 6-7 (brigands hit her only 23% true; she counter-killed two and drank vulneraries). Wil sat at the corridor dead end (10,3) and was never attacked. The javelin soldier (cls12) never attacked anyone all chapter even when adjacent.

(2) Ranged enemies shoot through walls: column 4 is hit from column 2, so never stand in the west corridor with an archer outside. (3) A cavalier at 12 HP on a two-attacker tile with no vulnerary is dead; rotate him out a turn earlier. (4) Enemy slots are recycled when reinforcements arrive — re-read fe7_state after every enemy phase before trusting a slot number. (5) The chapter ending ran straight through 8 Start presses into the Ch.5 opening; I did not catch the title card on screen.
- **Between chapters:** No save prompt or choice appeared. Nothing was chosen.

Two greens: Erk (cls20 mage, 10/17 HP) at (7,6) and Serra (cls1D cleric) at (6,6) — recruit by Talk is not possible with the tools, so keep them alive by killing what threatens them. - **Lost:** Nobody.
- **Gained:** Lyn L5 -> L6 (19 HP). Kent L6 -> L7 (S9 K9 P9) plus the brigand's Iron Sword drop (he now carries two Iron Swords). Florina L1 -> L2 (18 HP). Wil L2 -> L3 (21 HP). Both greens (Erk 10/17, Serra 3/17) survived; neither was recruited (no Talk).

The merc hit Serra twice (17 -> 3) before it died on turn 3. The other four were guard-type: Kent baited the (11,0) brigand at (8,2) on turn 5 and killed it turn 6; Kent killed the (14,2) archer from the house at (13,2) with a doubled 12x2 on turn 7 and the merc from (12,7) walked into his counter that enemy phase. Boss (Lv9 brigand, Steel Axe, 29 HP, D8, at (14,9)) never moved: Wil 4 dmg from (14,7) at range 2 with no counter, Lyn 6x2 at 100% from the forest at (14,8) (his hit on her there was 6% displayed / 0.8% true); his enemy-phase swing missed and Lyn's counter left him at 1, Wil finished on turn 11.
- **Sain:** slot #1 (cls28, 19/19, Iron Lance) is listed at Lyn's tile every turn but is NOT selectable (fe7_reachable decodes wrong; the phase ends without him). He is a ghost entry from the s06 death; the real roster is Lyn, Kent, Florina, Wil. Ch.6 still lists him at (4,3) — treat him as absent until proven otherwise.
- **Army (Ch.6 start):** Lyn L6 19/19, Mani Katti 32 (slot 0), Iron Sword 20, Vulnerary 3, Iron Axe 45. Kent L7 24/24, Iron Lance 34 (slot 0), Iron Sword 16, Iron Sword 46, no vulnerary. (2) The Mani Katti does not double an AS-8 merc and hits it at only 67% in forest; vs brigands and archers it is 100% and doubles. (3) Wil missed three 62-70% shots in a row; do not build a kill around his chip. (4) The boss is stationary; range-2 chip plus Lyn on the forest at (14,8) is a near-zero-risk kill. (5) Killing the last enemy with fe7_act ran straight through the ending into the Ch.6 title card in the same call — no save prompt was seen.
- **Between chapters:** No prompts appeared. Nothing was chosen.
- **Next:** Ch.6 Blood of Pride, turn 1, player phase, opening dialogue (Lyn/Sain in a city) still on screen — use fe7_wait/fe7_unstick first. 0 enemies listed yet, 7 greens (five cls47, a cls51 at (2,5), a cls3C at (0,13)) — the map is a city; read the objective from the opening screenshot after the cutscene. Lyn (4,5), Kent (17,10), Florina (6,5), Wil (2,3). State saved at playthrough/states/s07_ch06_blood-of-pride.ss.

## s08 — Ch.6 Blood of Pride (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 12

- **Lost:** Nobody.
- **Gained:** Rath (nomad, cls2E, L7, 25 HP, bow 0x32) joined as player #5 in the opening event; Matthew (thief, cls3C, L2, 18 HP, Iron Sword + Lockpick) joined automatically on turn 3 with no Talk needed. Florina got a Door Key (0x69) from the village at (7,8) and another from the soldier at (16,4) (one used). Matthew opened the chest at (12,6) and holds item 0x5A x1 (unidentified). The chest at (16,1) in the NE room was NOT opened. No level-ups seen.
- **What happened:** Objective "Hit switches" (three switches: (16,7) in the small SE room, (8,1) in the NW room, (12,1) in the boss room). Enemies: 2 mercs and a door soldier were the only movers; everything else was a guard. Turns 1-2 Kent baited both mercs at (8,10) and Kent/Rath/Lyn killed them. Turn 4 Rath doubled the door soldier from range 2 (13x2 kills every soldier here, no counter). Turn 6 Matthew opened the door (16,9) with `fe7_act door` (lockpick use dropped 15->14), Rath killed the room soldier, Kent stepped on (16,7) and the switch opened the big central room (10-17, 4-7; entrance from the west at (9,5)/(9,6)). Turn 8 Florina one-rounded the last soldier at (16,4) (10x2, took 5). Turn 10 Florina used a Door Key on (16,3) and Matthew lockpicked (8,3); Kent on (8,1) opened the boss room (11-13, 0-3). Lyn killed the archer at (12,2) from (12,3) before it could shoot Florina (bows do 22 to her). Boss Bool (knight, 26 HP, D10, Steel Lance 17 dmg to Lyn, never moves): Rath and Wil chipped 3x2 each from (13,2)/(12,3) with no counter for two turns, Kent finished at 99%. Lyn stepped on (12,1) and the chapter ended.
- **Army (Ch.7 start, game heals):** Lyn L6 19 HP, Mani Katti 29 (slot 0), Iron Sword 20, Vulnerary 3, Iron Axe 45. Kent L7 24 HP, Iron Lance ~32 (slot 0), Iron Sword 16, Iron Sword 46. Florina L2 18 HP, Slim Lance 22, Vulnerary 3, Door Key 1. Wil L3 21 HP, Iron Bow 37. Rath L7 25 HP, bow 0x32 x16, Vulnerary 3. Matthew L2 18 HP, Iron Sword 46, Lockpick 12, item 0x5A. The Sain ghost (slot with cls28 19 HP, lance 37) is benched on the prep screen.
- **Learned:** (1) `fe7_act door`/`chest`/`visit` all work; the confirm signal is the lockpick/key use dropping (or the new item appearing) plus a fe7_terrain re-read. (2) A switch fires the moment a unit lands on its tile — the Wait then reports "not confirmed" but the unit is spent and terrain changes; re-read fe7_terrain. Unrevealed rooms read as Roof (0x22). (3) Rath's bow doubles and kills 20-HP soldiers at range 2 with no counter; he is the best tool on this roster. (4) Archers three-fold damage on Florina: never end a turn with her in an archer's danger map. (5) Stationary bosses with D10 are best chipped from range 2 (Rath/Wil 3x2 each per turn) and finished by Kent. (6) The end-of-chapter Save screen highlighted slot 3 ("Ch. 6: Blood of Pride"), not slot 1 (which shows Ch.4); A on it, then A on Save. Ch.7 HAS a Preparations screen.
- **Between chapters:** Saved to game slot 3 (the highlighted one) at the Save prompt; one Start skipped the Ch.7 opening cutscene (Nils) and landed on the Preparations screen.
- **Next:** Ch.7 Siblings Abroad, turn 0, Preparations screen up (objective "Defeat Heintz"; press Start once to begin). 6 deployed: Lyn (3,4), Kent (1,1), Florina (2,2), Wil (4,2), Rath (1,3), Matthew (3,3). 11 enemies: 4 cls24 (probably shamans/dark mages; 22 HP) at (7,10), (5,5), (12,12), (5,11); 3 cls39 at (17,10), (12,4) (DROPS an Iron Lance), (9,13); mercs at (18,6), (13,7); archer at (10,1); a cls20 mage at (14,8). Nils (green, must survive?) may appear — read the objective screenshot. Slots re-sort after prep; re-read fe7_state. State saved at playthrough/states/s08_ch07_siblings-abroad.ss.

## s09 — Ch.7 Siblings Abroad (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 13

- **Lost:** Nobody.
- **Gained:** Lucius (monk, cls1C, L3, 18 HP, Lightning 0x3E x35, Res 6) joined on turn 1 as player #8 (appeared at (2,5) after the first moves). Nils (bard, cls41, 14 HP, only a Vulnerary) was deployed all chapter and never touched. Kent L7 -> L8 (25 HP, S10) plus the fighter's Iron Lance drop (he now carries two Iron Lances and two Iron Swords). Rath L7 -> L8 (26 HP). Wil L3 -> L4. Lyn and Florina no level. The village at (17,2) was destroyed by a fighter before Florina could reach it (turn 6; it reads as Ruins now, Visit was not offered).
- **What happened:** Objective "Defeat Heintz" (Lv5 shaman, 22 HP, D3 R5, Flux 1-2, on the Gate at (7,10); he never moved and gets D5/avo 37 on the gate). The start pocket (NW) is sealed from the south by peaks; the only exits are the bridge at (13,5) into mountains (infantry only) and the east bridge (17,4) then down the east edge, which has cliffs at (15,6)/(16,7)/(17,8). Turn 1 Kent killed the nearest shaman (11x2). Turns 3-5: a fighter, an archer, a merc and another fighter walked into the pocket one or two at a time and died to Wil chip + Kent/Lyn finishes and Rath's 10x2 on the archer. Turn 6 Rath doubled a fighter on the village. Turns 6-8 Kent baited the merc at (13,4), Rath baited the mage at (16,6) and the shaman at (16,9): each attacked him and died on his counter. Turns 9-11 the group crossed the east bridge and staged east of the gate; the last shaman came to Kent on the fort at (10,9) and Kent killed it on turn 12 from (9,9). Turn 12 Rath 8 from (9,10) and Florina 5 from (7,11) chipped the boss; on the enemy phase he hit Florina to 6 and Rath's counter left him at 6; turn 13 Rath's 9 at 80% killed him.
- **Army (Ch.7x start, game heals):** Lyn L6 19 HP, Mani Katti 28 (slot 0), Iron Sword 20, Vulnerary 3, Iron Axe 45. Kent L8 25 HP, Iron Lance 24 (slot 0), Iron Sword 16, Iron Sword 46, Iron Lance 45. Florina L2 18 HP, Slim Lance 20, Vulnerary 3, Door Key 1. Wil L4 21 HP, Iron Bow 31. Rath L8 26 HP, bow 0x32 x6 (nearly out — 6 uses left), Vulnerary 3. Matthew L2 18 HP, Iron Sword 46, Lockpick 12, item 0x5A. Nils L1 14 HP, Vulnerary 3. Lucius L3 18 HP, Lightning 35. Sain ghost still benched.
- **Learned:** (1) Rath's bow (0x32) is down to 6 uses; save it for kills that need range, and use Wil's Iron Bow (31) for chip. (2) Guard-type enemies here wake only when a unit ends inside their move+range; a cavalier on a tile the danger map shows as reachable by ONE enemy is a free kill via counter — except a lance cannot counter a range-2 shaman, so bait shamans with Rath (bow counters at 2) or accept one free hit. (3) Boss on a gate: no doubling (AS 7), D5, avo 37; each of Rath/Florina/Kent gets ~78% true for 8/5/13, and his counter is 8 (Res 2 units) or 6 (Florina). Never leave a unit under 9 HP adjacent to him. (4) fe7_reachable before planning cavalry moves near forests, forts and cliffs: forest cost 3, fort 2, cliffs impassable. (5) The boss kill ran straight into the Ch.7x title card in the same fe7_act call, then one Start from the map view landed on the Preparations screen. No save prompt appeared.
- **Between chapters:** No prompts appeared. Nothing was chosen. Ch.7x has a Preparations screen.
- **Next:** Ch.7x The Black Shadow, turn 0, Preparations screen up (objective "Defeat enemy" = rout; press Start once to begin). 8 deployed in the south: Lyn (12,14), Kent (7,16), Florina (13,14), Wil (10,14), Rath (11,15), Matthew (12,16), Nils (8,15), Lucius (9,16). 12 enemies: Lv7 merc boss (24 HP, sword 0x03 = Steel?) at (2,1) with a thief (2,2) and a soldier (1,2) beside him; soldiers (cls38, 20 HP, D0) at (12,9) and (3,12) (the latter DROPS a Vulnerary); mercs at (8,2), (11,2); fighters at (7,8), (4,4); archer (3,7); mage (10,7) with Thunder 0x38 and a Door Key; a cavalier (cls28, 20 HP, D6, lance+sword) at (14,1). The map is an indoor fortress (dark map; last session's Ch.7x notes in the earlier logs mention walls that ranged units shoot through). Slots re-sort after prep; re-read fe7_state. Nils must not die — keep him at the back. State saved at playthrough/states/s09_ch07x_the-black-shadow.ss.
